H3600.et: a form for (03564) (only in the dual)
H3600.def: a form for «03564» (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set): -ranges for pots.

H3601.def: from «03787»; literally, a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of a distaff («06418»), by which it is twirled:--spindle.

H3602.def: from «03541»; just so, referring to the previous or following context:--after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

H3603.def: from «03769»; a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, expec. the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large (round) coin):--loaf, morsel, piece, plain, talent.

H3605.def: or (Jer. 33:8) kowl {kole}; from «03634»; properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense):--(in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-)thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

H3606.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03605»:--all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be-(for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where)-fore, + though, what (where, who)-soever, (the) whole.

H3607.def: a primitive root; to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit):--finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.

H3609.def: apparently from «03607» and «01»; restraint of (his) father; Kilab, an Israelite:--Chileab.

H3610.et: dual of (03608) in the original sense of separation
H3610.def: dual of «03608» in the original sense of separation; two heterogeneities:--divers seeds (-e kinds), mingled (seed).

H3611.et: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack
H3611.def: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack; a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute:--dog.

H3612.et: perhaps a form of (03611), or else from the same root in the sense of forcible
H3612.def: perhaps a form of «03611», or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites:--Caleb.

H3613.def: from «03612» and «0672»; Caleb- Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct):--Caleb-ephrathah.

H3614.et: probably by erroneous transcription for Kalebiy {kaw-lay-bee'}
H3614.def: probably by erroneous transcription for Kalebiy {kaw-lay-bee'}; patronymically from «03612»; a Calebite or descendant of Caleb:--of the house of Caleb.

H3615.def: a primitive root; to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume):--accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when ... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, × fully, × have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.

H3617.def: from «03615»; a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction:--altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.

H3618.def: from «03634»; a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife:--bride, daughter-in-law, spouse.

H3619.def: from the same as «03611»; a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage):--basket, cage.

H3620.def: the same as «03619»; Kelub, the name of two Israelites:--Chelub.

H3621.def: a form of «03612»; Kelubai, an Israelite: -Chelubai.

H3623.def: denominative passive participle from «03618»; bridehood (only in the plural):--espousal.

H3624.et: from an unused root meaning to be complete
H3624.def: from an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity:--full (old) age.

H3625.def: the same as «03624»; Kelach, a place in Assyria: -Calah.

H3626.def: from «03605» and «02374»; every seer; Col- Chozeh, an Israelite:--Col-hozeh.

H3627.def: from «03615»; something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon):--armour ((-bearer)), artillery, bag, carriage, + furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, × one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, + psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, + whatsoever.

H3629.def: feminine of «03627» (only in the plural); a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self):--kidneys, reins.

H3630.def: a form of «03631»; Kiljon, an Israelite:--Chilion.

H3632.def: from «03634»; complete; as noun, the whole (specifically, a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb, fully:--all, every whit, flame, perfect(-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.

H3633.def: from «03557»; sustenance; Calcol, an Israelite:--Calcol, Chalcol.

H3634.def: a primitive root; to complete:--(make) perfect.

H3635.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03634»; to complete:--finish, make (set) up.

H3637.def: a primitive root; properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult:--be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.

H3638.def: of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire:--Chilmad.

H3641.def: or Kalneh {kal-nay'}; also Kalnow {kal-no'}; of foreign derivation; Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire:-- Calneh, Calno. Compare «03656».

H3642.def: a primitive root; to pine after:--long.

H3644.et: a form of the prefix "k-", but used separately [compare (03651)]
H3644.def: or kamow {kaw-mo'}; a form of the prefix "k-", but used separately (compare «03651»); as, thus, so:--according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.

H3645.et: from an unused root meaning to subdue
H3645.def: or (Jer. 48:7) Kmiysh {kem-eesh'}; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful; Kemosh, the god of the Moabites:--Chemosh.

H3646.et: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve
H3646.def: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve; "cummin" (from its use as a condiment):--cummin.

H3647.def: a primitive root; to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory:--lay up in store.

H3648.def: a primitive root; properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity):--be black, be kindled, yearn.

H3649.def: from «03648»; properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural):--Chemarims (idolatrous) priests.

H3650.def: redupl. from «03648»; obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural):--blackness.

H3651.def: from «03559»; properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles):--+ after that (this, -ward, -wards), as ... as, + (for-)asmuch as yet, + be (for which) cause, + following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), × the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, + there (where)-fore, this, thus, true, well, × you.

H3653.et: the same as (03651), used as a noun
H3653.def: the same as «03651», used as a noun; a stand, i.e. pedestal or station:--base, estate, foot, office, place, well.

H3654.et: from (03661) in the sense of fastening
H3654.def: from «03661» in the sense of fastening; a gnat (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irreg. in Exod. 8:17,18; Heb. 13:14)):--lice, × manner.

H3655.def: a primitive root; to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize:--give flattering titles, surname (himself).

H3656.def: for «03641»; Canneh, a place in Assyria:--Canneh.

H3658.et: from a unused root meaning to twang
H3658.def: from a unused root meaning to twang; a harp: -harp.

H3660.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03644»; so or thus:--so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.

H3661.def: a primitive root; to set out, i.e. plant:--X vineyard.

H3663.def: or Knanyahuw {ken-an-yaw'-hoo}; from «03661» and «03050»; Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite:--Chenaniah.

H3664.def: a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold: -gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3665.def: a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish:--bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

H3666.et: from (03665) in the sense of folding [compare (03664)]
H3666.def: from «03665» in the sense of folding (compare «03664»); a package:--wares.

H3667.def: from «03665»; humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him:--Canaan, merchant, traffick.

H3668.def: feminine of «03667»; Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites:--Chenaanah.

H3669.def: patrial from «03667»; a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans):--Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.

H3670.def: a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw:--be removed.

H3671.def: from «03670»; an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bed-clothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle:--+ bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), × flying, + (one an-)other, overspreading, × quarters, skirt, × sort, uttermost part, wing((-ed)).

H3672.et: respectively pl. and sing. fem. from the same as (03658)
H3672.def: or Kinnereth {kin-neh'-reth}; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as «03658»; perhaps harp-shaped; Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine:--Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.

H3674.def: from «03655»; a colleague (as having the same title):--companion.

H3676.et: apparently a contraction for (03678), but probably by erroneous transcription for (05251)
H3676.def: apparently a contraction for «03678», but probably by erroneous transcription for «05251»:--sworn.

H3677.def: or keceh {keh'-seh}; apparently from «03680»; properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival:--(time) appointed.

H3678.def: or kicceh {kis-say'}; from «03680»; properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied):--seat, stool, throne.

H3680.def: a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy):--clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare «03780».

H3681.def: passive participle of «03680»; properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering:--covering.

H3682.def: from «03680»; a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling:--covering, raiment, vesture.

H3683.def: a primitive root; to cut off:--cut down (up).

H3684.def: from «03688»; properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly:--fool(-ish).

H3685.def: the same as «03684»; any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one):--constellation, Orion.

H3686.def: the same as «03684»; Kesil, a place in Palestine: -Chesil.

H3688.def: a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly:--be foolish.

H3689.def: from «03688»; properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust:--confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

H3690.def: feminine of «03689»; in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness:--confidence, folly.

H3691.def: probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Heb. month:--Chisleu.

H3693.def: from «03688»; fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine:--Chesalon.

H3694.et: fem. pl. of pass. participle of (03688)
H3694.def: feminine plural of passive participle of «03688»; fattened; Kesulloth, a place in Palestine:--Chesulloth.

H3695.et: a plural probably of foreign derivation
H3695.def: a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians:--Casluhim.

H3696.et: from the fem. pl. of (03689) and (08396)
H3696.def: from the feminine plural of «03689» and «08396»; flanks of Tabor; Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine:--Chisloth- tabor.

H3697.def: a primitive root; to shear:--X only, poll. Compare «03765».

H3698.def: from «03697»; spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn):--fitches, rie.

H3699.def: a primitive root; to estimate:--make count.
